View Test Case
Preconditions
Same preconditions as FLOW-V2-CANDIDATE-SM-HOLD-01, plus a second, unrelated, already-completed Hold call from earlier in the session.
Steps
  1. Run FLOW-V2-CANDIDATE-SM-HOLD-01's chain up to Hold, then call SeatAfterHold using the pnr/gdsPNR/bookingToken from the earlier unrelated Hold call instead of this chain's own values. Do not proceed past the point where rejection is expected.
Expected Result
Request is rejected (exact status UNKNOWN -- confirm live), same class as TC-SEATAFTERHOLD-NEG-01 but exercised inside a full flow context rather than in isolation.
Actual Result
Actually attempted; the supplier-level rejection (BUG-03) fires before any identity check, so a stale identity cannot be told apart from a valid one. Not meaningfully testable for GulfAir. Unchanged from Rounds 1-6.
Findings12Defects7Unknown-resolution
Defect — BUG-18 (new)
Retrieve under-reports the per-passenger seat total on a multi-seat booking: paxTotalSeatAmount counts only one seat, so paxTotalAmount and the sum of the passenger totals fall short of priceDetails.totalAmount. The Book response for the same booking is correct. (SPEC.md §2.7, §2.9, §2.11, §5.4 row 49 (SM/A), §6.3, §6.4, FLOW-V2-49-SEATFIELD)
Field: selectedOffer.passengerFareBreakdown[].paxTotalSeatAmount / paxTotalAmount (Retrieve response)
Expected value: paxTotalSeatAmount {"amount":120,"currency":"SAR"} for two 60.00 seats, paxTotalAmount 1730.00, matching the Book response
Impact: A caller reading a booking back through Retrieve sees a seat total (60.00 instead of 120.00) and a per-passenger fare (1670.00 instead of 1730.00) that no longer add up to the booking total, so any invoice, refund or reconciliation built from the passenger lines is short by the missing seat(s). Not present in Round 6 (a round-trip Retrieve showed 240 for two 120 seats), so this looks like a regression. See full bug report.
Evidence: Round-trip pnr OOERGR (seats 14C + 14D, 60.00 each): Book paxTotalSeatAmount 120 / paxTotalAmount 1730; Retrieve (called twice) paxTotalSeatAmount 60 / paxTotalAmount 1670 while passengerSeats lists both seats and priceDetails.totalSelectedSeatsAmount is 120 / totalAmount 1730. Two-passenger round trip pnr OOBWZB (four seats): Book per-passenger seat total 100 each; Retrieve 60 each, per-passenger totals 1670 + 1670 = 3340 vs totalAmount 3420. One-seat booking ORUXWA is unaffected (60 = 60).
Defect — BUG-01, 7th confirmed occurrence (not new)
GetSeatMap accepts a ResponseId and selectedOfferId taken from two different offers and returns a full seat map; the result follows selectedOfferId and ResponseId is ignored. (SPEC.md §2.7, §7.7; User Story AC2, TC-SEATMAP-NEG-02)
Field: ResponseId / selectedOfferId
Expected value: 4xx validation error for a ResponseId/selectedOfferId pair that does not belong together
History: First observed Round 1 (2026-08-25); reproduced Rounds 1-3, 5, 6 (Round 4 blocked by an outage); not exercised Rounds 7-12; reproduced again Round 13 (2026-09-30).
Impact: The pair is not cross-validated, so a wrong or mixed-up identifier pair silently returns another itinerary's seat map instead of failing, and ResponseId adds no protection. See full bug report.
Evidence: ResponseId of chain A (BAH-RUH) with selectedOfferId of chain A2 (BAH-JED): 200, 28 rows (JED map); reverse pairing: 200, 30 rows (RUH map).
Defect — BUG-02, 7th confirmed occurrence (not new)
GetSeatMap documents ResponseId as required, but a request that omits it still returns HTTP 200 with the full seat map; the other three mandatory fields are rejected with 400. (SPEC.md §2.7, §7.7, §8.1-item2, TC-SEATMAP-NEG-04)
Field: ResponseId
Expected value: 400 validation error naming ResponseId, like supplier, credentialsSelector and selectedOfferId
History: First observed Round 1 (2026-08-25); reproduced Rounds 1-3, 5, 6 (not reproduced in Round 4); not exercised Rounds 7-12; reproduced again Round 13 (2026-09-30).
Impact: A required field is not enforced, so integrations that forget ResponseId work by accident and the documented contract cannot be trusted. See full bug report.
Evidence: omit supplier 400 "Select a valid Supplier"; omit credentialsSelector 400; omit selectedOfferId 400 "The SelectedOfferId field is required."; omit ResponseId 200 with 30 rows.
Defect — BUG-15, 7th confirmed occurrence (not new)
GetSeatMap returns HTTP 200 with a complete seat map for offers whose FareConfirm reports isSeatMapRequired=false; the flag is not enforced. (SPEC.md §2.2, §2.4, §2.7, §7.7; User Story AC2, TC-SEATMAP-NEG-01)
Field: isSeatMapRequired (FareConfirm) vs GetSeatMap response
Expected value: Rejection or an explicit not-supported envelope for an offer with isSeatMapRequired=false
History: Failing since Round 1 (2026-08-25), filed as its own BUG-15 in Round 5; reproduced Rounds 1-6; not exercised Rounds 7-12; reproduced again Round 13 (2026-09-30).
Impact: The capability flag cannot be used to decide whether to show seat selection, and callers get seat data for offers that are not flagged as seat-map offers. See full bug report.
Evidence: FareConfirm selectedOffer.isSeatMapRequired=false on all 51 calls this round; GetSeatMap 200 with 174 and 161 seat cells on chains A and A2.
Defect — BUG-17, 3rd confirmed occurrence (not new)
GetSeatMap does not reject a request whose credentialsSelector differs from the one the offer was created under (same supplier, different valid selector). (SPEC.md §7.14; User Story AC8 ("securely authenticates" -- caller-facing half only, see TC-SEATMAP-SEC-02), TC-SEATMAP-SEC-01)
Field: credentialsSelector
Expected value: 4xx rejection (offer not found / not authorized for this credentialsSelector), as happens when the supplier is switched
History: First observed Round 11 (2026-09-29); reproduced Round 12 (2026-09-30); reproduced again Round 13 (2026-09-30).
Impact: credentialsSelector is the per-tenant boundary; a caller holding an offerId/responseId from one tenant (KSA) can read that offer's seat map through another tenant's selector (UAE), so cross-tenant isolation rests only on offer IDs being unguessable. Other offer-consuming endpoints were not tested. See full bug report.
Evidence: Offer created under GulfAir/KSA; GetSeatMap with GulfAir/UAE -> 200, full seat map, same responseId; supplier switched to TravelportNdc/UAE -> 400 NDC-INT-TEC-A0001; invalid key / Client-Id -> 401.
Defect — BUG-07, 9th confirmed occurrence (not new)
Book accepts a cellId that was issued for a different offer's seat map: it runs the full booking, tickets it, and silently drops the seat (empty passengersSelectedSeats, no fee) instead of returning an error. (SPEC.md §2.7, §2.9, §7.7, TC-SEATMAP-VAL-04)
Field: passengersSelectedSeats.<paxRef>.setSegmentsSeats.<segmentRefId>.cellId
Expected value: 4xx validation error rejecting a cellId that does not belong to this offer, with no booking created
History: First observed Round 1 (2026-08-25); confirmed Rounds 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 11, 12 (Round 4 blocked by an outage); reproduced again Round 13 (2026-09-30).
Impact: The cellId token is not validated, so a stale or foreign token produces a booking with no seat and no error - the caller believes a seat was reserved. The same silent drop also happens for an unavailable or non-existent cellCode (TC-BOOK-NEG-05, TC-BOOK-NEG-09). See full bug report.
Evidence: Book on offer E2 (cellCode 15B) with the cellId of seat 15C from offer E1: 200, pnr RFMLTX, passengersSelectedSeats {}, totalSelectedSeatsAmount 0, no error.
Defect — BUG-06, 7th confirmed occurrence (not new)
Book accepts a tampered cellId (last 10 characters replaced) and books the seat named by cellCode; the token is never validated (also true for a cellId belonging to a different seat, TC-BOOK-VAL-06). (SPEC.md §2.7, §2.9, §7.7, TC-BOOK-NEG-06)
Field: passengersSelectedSeats.<paxRef>.setSegmentsSeats.<segmentRefId>.cellId
Expected value: 4xx rejection of a token that fails the server-side decode/signature check
History: First observed Round 1 (2026-08-25); reproduced Rounds 1-6; not exercised Rounds 7-12; reproduced again Round 13 (2026-09-30).
Impact: The opaque cellId adds no integrity protection; the seat is chosen from the free-text cellCode alone, so forged or mismatched tokens are accepted. See full bug report.
Evidence: Book (cellCode 14A, cellId with trailing XXXXXXXXXX): 200, pnr RALBKE, seat 14A attached at 60.00 SAR; Book (cellCode 15F, cellId of 15A): 200, pnr OWBPFD, seat 15F attached.
Defect — BUG-05, 7th confirmed occurrence (not new)
Book documents ResponseId as required, but a Book request that omits it is accepted and creates a real, ticketed PNR; the other three mandatory fields are rejected with 400. (SPEC.md §2.9, §7.7, §8.1-item2; SeatMap QC Execution Checklist.md §20, TC-BOOK-NEG-12)
Field: ResponseId
Expected value: 400 validation error naming ResponseId, no PNR created
History: First observed Round 1 (2026-08-25); reproduced Rounds 1-6; not exercised Rounds 7-12; reproduced again Round 13 (2026-09-30).
Impact: A required field is unenforced on the highest-blast-radius endpoint, and a malformed request still produces a real ticketed booking. See full bug report.
Evidence: omit ResponseId 200, pnr OWUAIY; omit selectedOfferId 400 A0001; omit supplier 400 1001; omit credentialsSelector 400 1001.
Defect — BUG-09, 9th confirmed occurrence (not new)
A child passenger can be assigned an exit-row seat: GetSeatMap offers and prices all 24 exit-row cells to the CHD, and Book accepts the assignment, creates the PNR and tickets both passengers. (SPEC.md §2.7 (cellCharacteristics), §2.9; NDC_Integration/Resources/SeatMap QC Execution Checklist.md Part 1 §15; Seat map - Seatmap.md TC-INT-BOOK-008, TC-BOOK-BIZ-05)
Field: passengersSelectedSeats.<paxRef> (CHD) / GetSeatMap passengersSeatMapAvailability
Expected value: Exit-row cells absent from the CHD passenger's allow-list, and Book rejecting the assignment (candidate RESTRICTED_EXIT_ROW_SEAT_FOR_CHILD) with no PNR created
History: First observed Round 1 (2026-08-25); confirmed Rounds 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 9, re-confirmed Round 12; reproduced again Round 13 (2026-09-30).
Impact: A safety rule (no children in exit rows) is enforced nowhere in the API; the seat map even labels exit rows NOT_ALLOWED_FOR_INFANTS and NOT_ALLOWED_FOR_MEDICAL but has no child restriction, so any client that calls the API directly can ticket a child in an exit row. See full bug report.
Evidence: ADT + CHD offer (BAH-DMM 2027-06-19): PAX2 (CHD) allow-list contains 10A and all 24 exit-row cells; Book 200, pnr OODUCQ, PAX2 seat 10A 60.00 SAR, both passengers ticketed.
Defect — BUG-03, 7th confirmed occurrence (not new)
SeatAfterHold rejects every call for supplier GulfAir with HTTP 409 OperationNotSupported ("GulfAir does not exist(s)") before reading any field, while GulfAir offers are Hold-capable and Hold succeeds. (SPEC.md §2.7a, TC-SEATAFTERHOLD-POS-01)
Field: SeatAfterHold response (supplier registration)
Expected value: 200 with the seat-selection response (or a documented validation error), or GulfAir being flagged as not supporting the operation before Hold is offered
History: First observed Round 1 (2026-08-25); reproduced Rounds 1-6; not exercised Rounds 7-12; reproduced again Round 13 (2026-09-30).
Impact: The Hold branch has no working seat-selection path for GulfAir, and six dependent test cases (VAL-01, NEG-01, NEG-02, VAL-02, INT-04, the candidate flows) cannot be evaluated. The same supplier-level 409 is now also returned by FareConfirmAfterHold (PnrReprice). See full bug report.
Evidence: SeatAfterHold 409 OperationNotSupported on 9 of 9 calls with valid credentials (every chain position, mismatched and stale identities, extra field, cross-tenant variants); Hold OTANEN 200 in the same run.
Defect — BUG-04, 7th confirmed occurrence (not new)
Hold returns holdExpirationDate null for GulfAir on every call, so a Held booking has no known expiry. (SPEC.md §2.7a, §2.12, §6.5, TC-SEATAFTERHOLD-NEG-02)
Field: holdExpirationDate
Expected value: "2026-10-01T14:32:10Z" (a future ISO-8601 timestamp)
History: First observed Round 1 (2026-08-25); reproduced every round through Round 6; not exercised Rounds 7-12; reproduced again Round 13 (2026-09-30).
Impact: Downstream cannot compute when a hold lapses, so expiry-based cleanup, the expired-hold negative tests and any customer-facing hold timer cannot work. See full bug report.
Evidence: holdExpirationDate null on 6 of 6 Hold calls this round (OTANEN, OOESWB, OWRLBM, OODBGD, OWZVVL, RKECRA).
Defect — BUG-08, 7th confirmed occurrence (not new)
Hold, documented as having no seat field, accepts passengersSelectedSeats, prices the seat into the held offer and Retrieve shows it on the OnHold booking, with no SeatAfterHold call. (SPEC.md §2.7a, §2.9, §2.10, §5.4 row 50 (SM/B), §5.5-item8, FLOW-V2-50-SEATFIELD)
Field: Hold request: passengersSelectedSeats
Expected value: The field ignored or rejected (per the documented contract), or the contract updated to say Hold honors seats
History: First observed Round 1 (2026-08-25); reproduced Rounds 1-3, 5, 6 (Round 4 blocked by an outage); not exercised Rounds 7-12; reproduced again Round 13 (2026-09-30).
Impact: The documented asymmetry between the Book and Hold branches is wrong for GulfAir, and an unvalidated seat selection (same unvalidated cellId as BUG-06/07) can be attached to a hold. See full bug report.
Evidence: Hold RKECRA with passengersSelectedSeats.PAX1 {14C}: 200, seat echoed at 60.00 SAR, totalSelectedSeatsAmount 60; Retrieve bookingStatus OnHold with the same seat.

cellAvailability/paxCellAvailability value "AvailableFree" is real on GulfAir too, but at the per-passenger level: seat 8E (bassinet seat) on the A320 GF103 flights shows paxCellAvailability AvailableFree for every passenger with explicit 0.00 SAR price objects, while the overall cellAvailability stays AvailablePaid. Differs from the AirArabia example, whose AvailableFree cells have null pricing. (TC-SEATMAP-BND-03)
Unknown-resolution
cellCategory "NoSeat" is a real value: a taken or absent seat is returned as cellCategory NoSeat with cellDetails null and column set (it never becomes Occupied/Blocked). No other category appeared on 34 narrowbody segments (aircraft 320, 321, 32N, 32Q). (TC-SEATMAP-BND-04)
Unknown-resolution
FareConfirmAfterHold (PnrReprice) is not supported for GulfAir: 409 OperationNotSupported "GulfAir does not exist(s)" on 5 of 5 calls, the same envelope as SeatAfterHold. BookAfterHold works without it (200, ticketed), so the documented Family B chain cannot be followed step by step for this supplier. (FLOW-V2-CANDIDATE-SM-HOLD-02)
Unknown-resolution
When a raw Book body repeats the same segmentRefId key twice under setSegmentsSeats, the server keeps the last value and drops the first without any error (System.Text.Json-style last-wins). (TC-BOOK-NEG-08)
Unknown-resolution
A schema-valid but non-existent cellCode ("99Z", with a real cellId borrowed from another seat) and an unavailable cellCode (NoSeat 8A with a borrowed cellId) are both accepted by Book with HTTP 200 and silently dropped: a ticketed booking is created with no seat and no fee. Same silent-drop family as BUG-07; a null cellId is the only rejected form (400 "CellId is required."). (TC-BOOK-NEG-09)
Unknown-resolution
GulfAir seat descriptions now include two restriction values not seen in Round 6: NOT_ALLOWED_FOR_INFANTS (exit-row cells only) and NOT_ALLOWED_FOR_MEDICAL (exit-row cells plus a few rear rows). There is still no wheelchair/accessibility value and no NOT_ALLOWED_FOR_CHILDREN value. (TC-BOOK-BIZ-07)
Unknown-resolution
Book rejects a duplicate seat inside one request in 0.1s (before any supplier call) with the generic envelope {ErrorCode NDC-INT-TEC-A0001, Context "Seat '17C' is assigned to multiple passengers on segment ..."}; the candidate code DUPLICATE_SEAT_SELECTION_IN_REQUEST is not used. Validation errors come in two envelope shapes: PascalCase {Status, ErrorCode "NDC-INT-TEC-A0001"} and camelCase {status, errorCode "1001"}. (TC-BOOK-NEG-07)

Also re-confirmed this round: BUG-11 (A naturally occurring supplier failure on FareConfirm (chain R4, BAH-CAI 2027-05-13) returned 409 NDC-INT-UNC-Z9999 with the raw upstream SOAP request, including live apiKey/secretKey, in OriginalSupplierRequest (values not recorded here)) — see TC-SEATMAP-NEG-05; BUG-09 (CHD offered every exit-row seat (24 of 24) in the seat map itself, also seen in TC-SEATMAP-BIZ-03) — see TC-BOOK-BIZ-05.

Not reproduced

BUG-16 (Book returns an error while silently creating the booking) — exercised by TC-SEATMAP-POS-02, TC-SEATMAP-VAL-03, TC-SEATMAP-VAL-04, TC-BOOK-POS-03, TC-BOOK-BND-03. All 16 Book calls (34-56 seconds each) and all 3 BookAfterHold calls returned a clean HTTP 200 with a pnr and bookingToken; none returned 409 NDC-INT-UNC-Z9999 or 500. Round 12 saw the failure on 4 of 4 Book calls, Rounds 9-11 saw none, so it is intermittent - recommend a wider re-verification before closing.
